design: exploratory numerical orbit checks, selected from the complete BSP1 trajectories
selection: Every BSP1 cell with a full-state recurrence candidate in 1..192; retain all noncandidates and failures under their actual labels.
initial_state: Last saved full float64 state from each BSP1 trajectory, bound by file hashes; singleton Newton changes batch layout and this is disclosed.
gates: Converged full-state closure below 1e-11 and every smaller positive lag separated by more than 1e-8.
All-step float64 dense monodromy, full spectrum, and numerical attraction only when spectral radius is below 1 minus 1e-8.
Dense product versus direct composed float64 JVP relative discrepancy below 1e-7.
Composed-map central differences with at least two consecutive observed orders in 1.5..2.5 and a relative error below 1e-5.
Eight-step Arnoldi refinement: leading spectral-radius relative difference below 1e-5 and relative residual below 1e-6.
Failed convergence, primitive-period or precision checks remain failed; no branch or crossing type inferred from shape.

reference_timing.description: Two completed A100 SD verification jobs, 23 cells through period48, including dense Jacobians twice per converged cell:625 and628 seconds including setup/retrieval.

resources.cost: see private ledger; inside the expanded total approval for scan and follow-up probes

scope: Representative full-state orbits and comparison with the mother shrimp. Geometry/boundary verification and publication remain separate.
